title: Fix Zwischenbericht TOC Aux File Undefined Control Sequence
description: Building the zwischenbericht print template (`bun ./📜️script.ts build zwischenbericht` from print/) fails with `error: zwischenbericht.register-toc:1: Undefined control sequence` during the TeX rerun after `\maketableofcontents`. The written .register-toc aux line contains mis-escaped tokens derived from the document title (e.g. `\title{Zwischenbericht Beispielprojekt}`). Root cause is in print/tex/semio-window.sty around the TOC write path (`\semio_window_toc_append:nnn`, `\SemioTocAuxLine`/`\semio_window_toc_aux_line:nnn`, `\semio_window_toc_iow_open:`) where the title token list is written to the aux file without safe catcode/expansion handling, so titles containing spaces round-trip unsafely when the file is read back in on the next TeX run. Fix the write path so .register-toc lines are safe to read back for titles with spaces (forschungsbericht doesn't call \maketableofcontents so it isn't affected). Verify with `bun ./📜️script.ts build zwischenbericht` succeeding cleanly.
summary: Fixed three chained expl3 bugs in the TOC register mechanism that only surfaced when a template calls \maketableofcontents with non-empty entries (zwischenbericht), while forschungsbericht (no \maketableofcontents) masked them: (1) semio_window_toc_aux_line:nnn called the nonexistent \str_trim_spaces:N — replaced with \tl_trim_spaces:N; (2) the label seq push used \exp_args:NV (wrongly V-expanding the seq variable itself, corrupting expansion and swallowing following tokens) — fixed to \exp_args:NNV so the seq variable passes through unchanged and only the scalar is V-expanded; (3) semio_window_toc_seq_sanitize: fed \bool_lazy_or:nnTF two \tl_if_in:NnT TF-conditionals instead of boolean predicates, and the nonexistent \tl_if_in_p:Nn predicate variant doesn't exist in this expl3 build — replaced with nested \tl_if_in:NnTF calls. Verified `bun ./📜️script.ts build zwischenbericht` and `bun ./📜️script.ts build forschungsbericht` both exit 0 producing light/dark PDFs with no undefined-control-sequence or missing-number errors.
